booksRead.title: Let It Glow
booksRead.author: Marissa Meyer
booksRead.thoughts: I have read it 4 times in the last year and I LOVE it!!! It is one of the best books ever in my opinion. It is a holiday book about both Christmas 🎄 and Hanukkah 🕎. Happy Holidays!
